第13章 第一批追随者（第1页）
追梦接着又说道:“招聘护院，要求年龄10岁到18岁，为人言而有信，能忠心护主的，人数10人。
从追梦家开始销售酒水开始，追梦家一天的收入就已经有上100两黄金，现在正是培养发展壮大自己势力的时候，多出点银钱招聘人数，追梦还是非常舍得的。
在来邹家村前，追梦特意找养父邹铁牛了解了一下，起源大陆武功修为境界的等级划分。
邹铁牛说，起源大陆武功修为境界分，1级学徒，2级初级武者，3级普通武者，4级精英武者，5级初级武士，6级中等武士，7级精英武士，8级初级武师，9级中等武师，10级精英大武师，每一级还前期后期大圆满三个境界。
后面还朦胧的提到，好像10级之后还有更高的修为境界，但邹家村崇祠里只提到，没有记录具体修为境界，如果村里出现天骄妖孽，可以送到一级主城级以上的主城修炼。
邹家村村民武功修为境界一般都是一级学徒，很少有二级初级武者，至于三级普通武者经常都是村长特有。
追梦经过一番筛选，10名护院被追梦选好，都是青一色男子，3个学徒前期，4学徒后期，3个学徒大圆满。
在丫鬟和护卫都招聘够后，追梦才有时间来安排邹麻子等人。
第1条路就是，邹麻子他们今后跟随着追梦，成为追梦的好兄弟和好兄妹，需要发下天道契约，今后有福同享，有难同当。
传说，天道契约对普通人或低修为境界的人来说，是没什么用的，但修为境界越高约束越大，特别到了圣人层次，天道契约是可以决定圣人生死的。
追梦之所以要和邹麻子他们签下天道契约，而不是普通的契约，是因为追梦感得，他们今后修为境界成就低的话，对自己无用，修为境界很高的话，普通的契约又没有约束力，才有签定只存在传说中的天道契约的事。
第2条路就是签定普通契约，签定普通契约同样是追梦的好兄弟和好兄妹，同样可以有福同享，有难同当。
但这样追梦决定，待自己记忆恢复后，只会挑选一些普通的修炼功法传授，一些大的密密也不让他们知道。
第3条路就是，如果邹麻子他们选择第3条路，追梦还是当他们是好兄弟和好兄妹，但只保持现有的关系，做这一世的朋友。
因为保持现有的关系，待追梦记忆恢复后，追梦不会传授他们任何修炼功法。
邹麻子他们在没有追梦传授任何功法的情况下，这个世界的正常运转下，他们只能做一个凡人。
凡人死后灵魂进入轮回，不记得前世记忆，所以说只能和追梦做这一世的好兄弟和好兄妹。

让追梦感到高兴的是，几人最后的决定都是选择第1条路。
当天，几人当着众村民面，指着上天签定了天道契约。
从此，追梦是大哥，麻子是老2，狗蛋是老3，小花是老4，二妞三妞分别是老5老6。

Chapter 13 The first followers (page 1)
Zhui Meng then said: "Recruiting nursing homes requires 10 to 18-year-olds who are trustworthy and can loyally protect the Lord. The number is 10.
Ever since Dream Chaser started selling drinks, Dream Chaser's daily income has been over 100 taels of gold. Now is the time to cultivate, develop and expand one's own power, and Dream Chaser is still willing to spend more money to recruit people.
Before coming to Zoujia Village, Zhuimeng asked his adoptive father Zou Tieniu to find out more about the levels of martial arts cultivation in the Origin Continent.
Zou Tieniu said that the realms of martial arts cultivation in Origin Continent are divided into level 1 apprentice, level 2 junior martial artist, level 3 ordinary martial artist, level 4 elite warrior, level 5 junior warrior, level 6 intermediate warrior, level 7 elite warrior, level 8 junior martial artist, level 9 intermediate martial artist, and level 10 elite great martial artist. Each level has three realms of early and late stages of perfection.
It was vaguely mentioned later that there seemed to be higher cultivation realms after level 10, but the Zoujiacun Chongci only mentioned that there was no record of the specific cultivation realms. If a genius or evildoer appeared in the village, they could be sent to a main city above the first-level main city level to practice.
The martial arts cultivation level of the villagers in Zoujia Village is generally first-level apprentices, and there are very few second-level junior martial artists. As for third-level ordinary warriors, they are often unique to the village chief.
After some screening by Dream Chaser, 10 nursing students were selected by Dream Chaser. They were all green men, 3 early apprentices, 4 late apprentices, and 3 apprentices.
After recruiting enough maids and guards, Zhui Meng had time to arrange for Zou Mazi and others.
The first way is for Zou Mazi and the others to follow Dream Chaser and become good brothers and sisters of Dream Chaser. They need to make a contract with Heaven to share blessings and share hardships in the future.
Legend has it that the contract of heaven is of little use to ordinary people or people with low cultivation levels, but the higher the level of cultivation, the greater the restrictions. Especially at the level of a saint, the contract of heaven can determine the life or death of a saint.
The reason Zhui Meng wanted to sign a contract with Zou Mazi and the others instead of an ordinary contract was because Zhui Meng felt that if their cultivation level was low in the future, it would be of no use to him. If their cultivation level was high, ordinary contracts would not be binding, so they signed the legendary contract with Heaven.
The second way is to sign an ordinary contract. Signing an ordinary contract is also a good brother and sister chasing dreams. They can also share blessings and share difficulties.
But I decided to pursue my dream like this. After my memory recovers, I will only choose some common cultivation techniques to teach them, and I will not let them know some big secrets.
The third way is, if Zou Mazi and the others choose the third way, Chai Meng should treat them as good brothers and good siblings, but they will only maintain the existing relationship and be friends in this life.
Because of maintaining the existing relationship, Zhui Meng will not teach them any cultivation techniques after Meng Zhui's memory is restored.
Without Chai Meng teaching any skills to Zou Mazi and the others, under the normal operation of this world, they could only be mortals.
After the death of a mortal, the soul enters reincarnation and cannot remember the memory of the previous life, so it is said that he can only be a good brother and good brother and sister with Zhui Meng in this life.
What makes Zhui Meng happy is that the final decision of several people was to choose the first path.
That day, in front of all the villagers, several people pointed to heaven and signed a contract of heaven.
From then on, Zhui Meng was the eldest brother, Mazi was the second brother, Goudan was the third brother, Xiaohua was the fourth brother, and the second and third girls were the fifth and sixth brothers respectively.
